title: Sinigang-Style Kid-Friendly Nduja Stew
description: A flavorful and spicy Filipino-inspired stew featuring the bold flavors of sinigang and the richness of nduja.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of water in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until softened.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the nduja and stir until fragrant.
Add the halved tomatoes and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the sinigang mix and stir to combine.
Add the sliced bamboo shoots and stir to combine.
Pour in 4 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 15-20 minutes.
Season with fish sauce to taste (if using).
Serve hot with steamed rice or noodles.
